visual.description: Single-row full-width dark bar with centered uppercase text link and a close button on the far right.
Navigation splits into three zones: hamburger+Search on left, centered logo, and utility icons (language, account, wishlist, cart) on right.
Full-viewport-width video/image hero with a pause control bottom-left; no text overlay visible in first screenshot due to modal obstruction.
Centered modal splits 50/50: left half is a terracotta-background image panel, right half is white with eyebrow text, large serif headline, body copy, a pill CTA button, and a text dismiss link.
Six equal-width columns each containing a product image above a category label, forming a horizontal browse strip.
Full-width row divided into two equal halves, each filled edge-to-edge with a distinct product lifestyle photograph.
Another equal two-column media row showing contrasting product scenes side by side with no gutter.
Left column is a full-bleed product photo; right column contains a small eyebrow label, large serif headline, body paragraph, and an underlined text link, vertically centered.
Left half is a lifestyle image; right half holds an eyebrow 'PRODUCT STORY' label and a large multi-line serif headline, with text appearing bottom-anchored.
Full-width dark-toned image with an oversized, low-opacity branded wordmark centered horizontally in the lower half.

Two-column row where the left column is a muted olive/grey background with an abstract circular shape, and the right column is a warm brown product photo; text block sits in the lower-left of the left column.
Equal two-column split with a sofa lifestyle image on the left and a grey neutral background with vertically centered text and underlined CTA on the right.
Left column holds eyebrow label, large display headline, three-line body copy, and underlined link; right column is a full-bleed product lifestyle photo.
Full-width near-black band containing a country-selector pill on the left and an arrow-up scroll-to-top button on the right.
Dark footer splits into two equal columns of stacked text navigation links (Store locator, Material Library, Shipping & Returns, FAQ on left; Newsletter, Press Area, Trade Program on right).
Bottom footer row places five social media icons left-aligned and a horizontal row of legal links plus copyright right-aligned, all on a black background.
